title: NC-PLUS-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-13-t485: Cut D1 read costs: replace per-request status polling with single batched query in verify-deploy worker
body:

**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-13-t485 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer

Cut D1 read costs: replace per-request status polling with single batched query in verify-deploy worker

Backlog done check: k_eff >= 1 or measured D1 queries per deploy cycle reduced by >=50% vs baseline t485 (currently ~18 queries/deploy)

Triage: Replacing per-request polling with a batched query requires editing the verify-deploy worker source; the in-Worker doer can only touch the backlog DB. | first step: File a code-change ticket to refactor verify-deploy into a single batched status query, then run the wrangler-tail instrumented harness.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
